Hi Alex / Priya / Zhang,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. The Kestrel architects asked for a focused 45-minute technical deep-dive with our solutions engineering team to walk through a sample inference pipeline and KV cache behavior under mixed-latency traffic. Goal: make sure the architecture meets your throughput/latency SLAs before the pilot.

We want to include: Neha (SE — runtime & deployment), Marissa (solutions PM — integration notes), and 2-3 of your architects.

Because your team spans APAC and we have US + EU engineers involved, I'm hoping we can land on a single 45-minute window that minimizes extreme hours. Attaching a short timezone-proposal PDF and a pre-demo checklist so we don't spend time on access/config in the session.

Initial options we can try to anchor on:
- 14:00 UTC (07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 16:00 CEST / 22:00 SGT) — 45 minutes
- 20:00 UTC (13:00 PT / 16:00 ET / 22:00 CEST / 04:00 SGT next day) — not ideal for APAC

If neither works, can you share a 3-slot availability matrix in UTC and we'll pick the best one. We realize DST transitions are coming up for some EU customers later in the year; if you prefer we can pick an "UTC anchor" slot to avoid ambiguity across calendars.

Proposed time window preference: anchor on UTC so invites don't drift when DST flips.

Action: can you confirm the names of the two architects who will join and 1–2 preferred UTC times?

Thanks — will send a calendar stub once we lock a slot.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
